MWCD Internship for Women Students & Scholars

Policy and programme internship with the Ministry of Women and Child Development for women students, scholars, social activists and teachers.

STIPEND / MONTH
₹20,000
Stipend details
₹20,000 per month plus travel reimbursement and hostel accommodation.
Next cycle deadline
To be confirmed
Format & location
In person · New Delhi
Who can apply
Women students (UG/PG/research), scholars, social activists and teachers. Law, social work, gender studies, public policy and allied fields are common.
Accommodation & support
Hostel accommodation and travel reimbursement provided

Entry notes

  • The latest reported cycle closed on 10 September 2026; the ministry runs it in batches, so check for the next call.
